instruction: You are given a template `/home/user/Desktop/wind_sector_base.py`. Complete the following from the command line: 1. Write a complete script `/home/user/Desktop/wind_sector.py`: - Build a 3x3 regular layout with spacing `7D` - Wind-direction sectors: `0, 30, 60,..., 330` (12 sectors) - Wind speed `8 m/s`, `TI=0.06` - Set conditions in vectorized form and run - Extract per-sector per-turbine power as a `12x9` matrix 2. Save the matrix to `/home/user/Desktop/power_matrix.csv` (one sector per row, one turbine per column). 3. Extract and save statistics to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` in this format: `max_sector_total_kw, min_sector_total_kw, wake_loss_max_percent` where `wake_loss_max_percent = (P_nowake - P_min) / P_nowake * 100` 4. Do not use any GUI. [Software] Run your scripts with Python in an environment where `floris` is installed (e.g. `from floris import FlorisModel`).
